props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the checked radio when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the radio group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If `true`, the radio group will be disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the radio. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: If `true`, the radio group is marked as invalid.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the input fields in the radio
(Useful for form submission).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function called once a radio is checked

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the radio group is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: If `true`, the radio group is marked as required.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the radio group
